title: Commodity traders - the Russian-oil price cap, the shadow fleet, and the bribery track (kept separate)
source: Public record: Russian oil price cap (Dec 2022: $60 Urals + $100/$45 products; EU shifted to a dynamic formula late 2025 (~$48), then FROZE the seaborne crude cap at $44.10 via the 21st Sanctions Package, mid-2026). Evasion via a 'shadow fleet' of 600-700 tankers (up from ~200-300) using ship-to-ship transfers, re-flagging, non-coalition intermediaries, and falsified docs - tactics modeled on Iran. Gunvor: publicly pledged to exit Russian oil, but a 'strictly confidential' report acknowledged subsidiaries transacted with sanctioned Russian counterparties (Gazprom/Rosneft/Lukoil/Novatek) ~0.69% of Q1-2024 group revenue (~$234M per Goteborgs-Posten estimate); Gunvor's OFFICIAL position: it stopped trading Russian crude and handles only 'very small volumes' of compliant Russian oil products. SEPARATE corruption track (Latin America, pre-shadow-fleet): Gunvor pleaded guilty + paid >$661M (US FCPA, Ecuador/Petroecuador 2024) + ~$98M to Swiss authorities; Vitol paid ~$90M (US) + ~$29M (CFTC) + ~$45M back to Petrobras (DPA, Brazil); Trafigura pleaded guilty (~$127M fines+forfeiture). Overlay on the commodity-trading-houses + Russia + OPEC threads; structural edges only. HONESTY: cap mechanics, shadow-fleet scale, the FCPA settlements, and Gunvor's confidential-report figure + its official denial = fact (both Gunvor positions presented); the FCPA/corruption track is EXPLICITLY DISTINCT from Russian sanctions evasion (the sources do not link them); no claim that any named house operates the shadow fleet.

edges.notes: G7/EU price cap: Dec 2022 $60 Urals (+$100/$45 products); late-2025 shift to a dynamic formula (~15% below 6-mo average, ~$48); mid-2026 the seaborne crude cap was FROZEN at $44.10 via the EU 21st Sanctions Package. The lever meant to cap Russia's oil revenue while keeping barrels flowing (fact).

The ~600-700-vessel 'shadow fleet' (from ~200-300) is how Russia evades the cap: ship-to-ship transfers in international waters, re-flagging in low-oversight jurisdictions, non-coalition intermediaries to break the compliance chain, falsified origin/destination docs - tactics modeled on Iran (fact of the evasion architecture).
Russia's shadow fleet lets it export crude outside Western insurance/services, narrowing the Brent-Urals discount over time - the structural workaround to the cap (fact).

CONTESTED, both positions given: Gunvor publicly pledged to exit Russian oil, but a 'strictly confidential' report acknowledged its subsidiaries transacted with sanctioned Russian counterparties (Gazprom/Rosneft/Lukoil/Novatek) at ~0.69% of Q1-2024 group revenue (~$234M, Goteborgs-Posten estimate). Gunvor's OFFICIAL position: it stopped trading Russian crude and handles only 'very small volumes' of sanctions-compliant Russian oil products. Fact of both the report figure AND the company's denial - presented side by side, not resolved.
Lukoil is one of the major Russian energy groups named among the sanctioned counterparties in the Gunvor confidential report (alongside Gazprom/Rosneft/Novatek) (fact of the naming).

SEPARATE CORRUPTION TRACK (not Russia): Gunvor S.A. pleaded guilty + agreed to pay >$661M to resolve a US FCPA case over bribes to Ecuadorean officials for Petroecuador business (2024), plus ~$98M to Swiss authorities. Distinct from the Russia-sanctions question (fact; explicitly a different matter).

SEPARATE CORRUPTION TRACK: Vitol paid ~$90M (US criminal) + ~$29M (CFTC) + ~$45M back to Petrobras under a Deferred Prosecution Agreement over Brazil/Ecuador/Mexico bribery - Latin America, pre-shadow-fleet, NOT Russian sanctions (fact).
SEPARATE CORRUPTION TRACK: Trafigura pleaded guilty in a US bribery case (~$127M in fines + forfeiture) - again Latin-America corruption, distinct from the Russia-sanctions track (fact).

Net effect: the cap + shadow fleet reshaped the physical crude market (the Urals-Brent wedge, redirected flows to India/China, a parallel non-Western insurance/shipping stack) - the plumbing the trading houses + OPEC+ operate within (fact of the market shift; magnitude evolving).

Sanctioned Russian barrels rerouted at a discount interact with OPEC+ quota management - a structural complication for the cartel's price control (interpretation of the interaction; fact that both forces act on the same market).
